edits.new:
Scenario: AC11 The rule versioning, ownership, call and personal data rules hold across the run (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an earlier retention run recorded its rule version
    Given a new retention rule version is loaded with a valid-from date
    When the retention run completes on or after the valid-from date
    Then each data product and table has one retention rule in force, held as a versioned data row
    Then the run records the new version and the earlier run keeps its recorded version
    Then only rwb-document holds the retention rule table and takes the retention action
    Then each owning service applies the rule to its own schema and the suite asserts only through the owner's contract or API
    Then every cross-service call of the suite is one hop with a 2 s timeout
    Then the run record, the archive manifest assertion, the evidence report and the fixtures hold identifiers and counts only and no personal data

  Scenario: AC12 A retried or timed-out activity does not duplicate the archive or delete a live record (new, D-RCV-60)
